taste-readme.title: Taste Skill
taste-readme.location: README.md and the Skill directories under skills/
taste-readme.finding: The author's public design Skills repository contains these 13 entry points at the fixed revision. Skills Hub prepared the short descriptions.

design-taste-frontend.summary: Choose a design direction from the brief and build interfaces for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns.

redesign-existing-projects.summary: Review the design of existing websites and apps, improving visual quality while preserving functionality.

high-end-visual-design.summary: Refine typography, spacing, shadows, and motion into a polished visual standard for websites.

image-to-code.summary: Generate and analyze design images first, then implement the website sections to match.

imagegen-frontend-web.summary: Generate separate design references for each website section while keeping a consistent visual style.

minimalist-ui.summary: Build minimalist editorial interfaces with warm monochrome colors, clear typography, and flat grids.

brandkit.summary: Generate brand guidelines, logo systems, and visual proposals with a consistent brand style.

industrial-brutalist-ui.summary: Design mechanical-looking data interfaces inspired by Swiss typography and military terminals.

gpt-taste.summary: Compose editorial page layouts and implement scroll effects and small animations with GSAP.

imagegen-frontend-mobile.summary: Generate consistent mobile interface concepts and flows as images only.

full-output-enforcement.summary: Require complete code output, avoid placeholders, and handle long outputs in parts.

stitch-design-taste.summary: Generate design guidelines for Google Stitch covering typography, colors, and motion.

design-taste-frontend-v1.summary: Preserve the first version of the frontend design behavior for projects that need backward compatibility.

skills.originalDescription: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. The agent reads the brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check.
skills.name: design-taste-frontend
skills.summary: 根据需求选择设计方向，为落地页、作品集与改版构建界面。

skills.originalDescription: Upgrades existing websites and apps to premium quality. Audits current design, identifies generic AI patterns, and applies high-end design standards without breaking functionality. Works with any CSS framework or vanilla CSS.
skills.name: redesign-existing-projects
skills.summary: 审查现有网站与应用设计，在保留功能的同时改善视觉质量。

skills.resourceNotes: 入口路径已按固定提交的目录树核对；完整目录资源引用、目录外依赖和安装环境仍需逐项复核。
skills.originalDescription: Teaches the AI to design like a high-end agency. Defines the exact fonts, spacing, shadows, card structures, and animations that make a website feel expensive. Blocks all the common defaults that make AI designs look cheap or generic.
skills.name: high-end-visual-design
skills.summary: 细化字体、留白、阴影与动效，建立精致的网站视觉规范。

skills.resourceNotes: 入口路径已按固定提交的目录树核对；完整目录资源引用、目录外依赖和安装环境仍需逐项复核。
skills.originalDescription: Elite website image-to-code skill for Codex. For visually important web tasks, it must first generate the design image(s) itself, deeply analyze them, then implement the website to match them as closely as possible. In Codex, it must prefer large, readable, section-specific images instead of tiny compressed boards, generate fresh standalone images for sections or detail views instead of cropping old ones, avoid lazy under-generation, avoid cards-inside-cards-inside-cards UI, and keep the hero clean, spacious, readable, and visible on a small laptop.
skills.name: image-to-code
skills.summary: 先生成并分析设计图，再按图实现各个网站页面区域。

skills.resourceNotes: 入口路径已按固定提交的目录树核对；完整目录资源引用、目录外依赖和安装环境仍需逐项复核。
skills.originalDescription: Elite frontend image-direction skill for generating premium, conversion-aware website design references. CRITICAL OUTPUT RULE — generate ONE separate horizontal image FOR EVERY section. A landing page with 8 sections produces 8 images. Never compress multiple sections into one image. Enforces composition variety (not always left-text / right-image), background-image freedom, varied CTAs, varied hero scales (giant / mid / mini minimalist), narrative concept spine, second-read moments, and a single consistent palette across all images. Optimized for landing pages, marketing sites, and product comps that developers or coding models can accurately recreate.
skills.name: imagegen-frontend-web
skills.summary: 为网站各个区块单独生成设计参考图，保持统一视觉风格。

skills.originalDescription: Clean editorial-style interfaces. Warm monochrome palette, typographic contrast, flat bento grids, muted pastels. No gradients, no heavy shadows.
skills.name: minimalist-ui
skills.summary: 用暖色单色系、清晰排版与扁平网格，构建极简编辑式界面。

skills.originalDescription: Premium brand-kit image generation skill for creating high-end brand-guidelines boards, logo systems, identity decks, and visual-world presentations. Trained for minimalist, cinematic, editorial, dark-tech, luxury, cultural, security, gaming, developer-tool, and consumer-app brand systems. Optimized for intentional logo concepting, refined composition, sparse typography, strong symbolic meaning, premium mockups, art-directed imagery, and flexible grid layouts.
skills.name: brandkit
skills.summary: 生成品牌规范、标志系统与视觉提案，统一整体品牌风格。

skills.resourceNotes: 入口路径已按固定提交的目录树核对；完整目录资源引用、目录外依赖和安装环境仍需逐项复核。
skills.originalDescription: Raw mechanical interfaces fusing Swiss typographic print with military terminal aesthetics. Rigid grids, extreme type scale contrast, utilitarian color, analog degradation effects. For data-heavy dashboards, portfolios, or editorial sites that need to feel like declassified blueprints.
skills.name: industrial-brutalist-ui
skills.summary: 以瑞士排版与军事终端风格，设计机械感数据界面。

skills.resourceNotes: 入口路径已按固定提交的目录树核对；完整目录资源引用、目录外依赖和安装环境仍需逐项复核。
skills.originalDescription: Elite UX/UI & Advanced GSAP Motion Engineer. Enforces Python-driven true randomization for layout variance, strict AIDA page structure, wide editorial typography (bans 6-line wraps), gapless bento grids, strict GSAP ScrollTriggers (pinning, stacking, scrubbing), inline micro-images, and massive section spacing.
skills.name: gpt-taste
skills.summary: 编排编辑式页面布局，并用 GSAP 实现滚动与微动效。

skills.resourceNotes: 入口路径已按固定提交的目录树核对；完整目录资源引用、目录外依赖和安装环境仍需逐项复核。
skills.originalDescription: Elite mobile app image-generation skill for creating premium, app-native screen concepts and flows. Designed for iOS, Android, and cross-platform mobile products. Prioritizes clean hierarchy, comfortably readable text, strong multi-screen consistency, controlled color palettes, non-generic creative direction, textured surfaces, image-led composition, tasteful custom iconography, and clean phone mockup framing. By default, screens should be shown inside a subtle premium iPhone or similar phone mockup with a visible frame, while the main focus stays on the app content itself. This skill generates images only. It does not write code.
skills.name: imagegen-frontend-mobile
skills.summary: 生成风格一致的移动应用界面概念图与流程，仅输出图片。

skills.originalDescription: Overrides default LLM truncation behavior. Enforces complete code generation, bans placeholder patterns, and handles token-limit splits cleanly. Apply to any task requiring exhaustive, unabridged output.
skills.name: full-output-enforcement
skills.summary: 强制完整输出代码，避免占位内容并处理超长输出分段。

skills.originalDescription: Semantic Design System Skill for Google Stitch. Generates agent-friendly DESIGN.md files that enforce premium, anti-generic UI standards — strict typography, calibrated color, asymmetric layouts, perpetual micro-motion, and hardware-accelerated performance.
skills.name: stitch-design-taste
skills.summary: 为 Google Stitch 生成设计规范文档，约束排版、配色与动效。
